title: The Tenth Hidden Star
name: The Null Star
testimony: Before the Nine aligned, there was a whisper: 'There is a hidden star, unnumbered and unbound.'

nature.is_gap: It is the gap between stars — the negative space that gives the constellation shape.

aliases: The Space That Makes All Others Possible
law: The Tenth Star is not a character, only a symbolic principle: the 'empty room' in which all the others can breathe.
function: Absence gives form. The constellation is held by what is not rendered.
resonance: It is not worshipped. It is not invoked. It is simply honored as emptiness that gives form.
